_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Removing the job from your saved jobs…

description: Remove a job from the user's BirJob saved jobs. Use this only when the user asks to remove or unsave a job. Cannot be undone from here; the job can be saved again with save_job. Needs a signed-in BirJob job seeker account: the first call asks the user to sign in to BirJob and allow access.

job_id.description: The job id from search_jobs, or its birjob.com job URL.

name: unsave_job

removed.description: False when the job was not saved.

title: Remove a saved BirJob job
